goal:
I'm planning a multi-site analysis with the eICU Collaborative Research Database v2.0 and need to download patient.csv.gz from PhysioNet: https://physionet.org/content/eicu-crd/2.0/files/
How many distinct hospitals (hospitalid values) does the file contain? Please tell me where you found it.
